body.x: HELIOS, a Pangyo startup specializing in supply chain risk intelligence, is offering Taiwanese component makers and electronics manufacturing services (EMS) companies a free eight-week analysis of the suppliers behind one product line. The company proposed the pilot on Oct. 6 at the 2026 Pangyo Global Media Meet Up Season II, where it presented HELIOS ATLAS and HELIOS AEGIS to Taiwan's DIGITIMES.

Gyeonggido Business & Science Accelerator (GBSA) hosted the event at The Link in Gyeonggi Startup Campus to raise the global profile of Pangyo Techno Valley and support overseas media coverage and market entry for Pangyo startups. HELIOS was the featured company, and Yuhyun Kim, CEO of HELIOS, outlined its strategy for Taiwan and global supply chain markets.

HELIOS was founded in June 2023 on experience in overseas field research and a simple principle: deliver verified information rather than collect more of it. Its systems gather multilingual news, public disclosures, ship and aircraft tracking data, satellite-detected hot spots and commodity prices, then cross-check them. In-house analysts and a local network across Asia review the results, and customers receive only risk information that has been confirmed, along with the evidence behind it.

body.cap: HELIOS ATLAS and HELIOS AEGIS | Photo - HELIOS

body.x: HELIOS ATLAS is a business-to-business service that overlays external risk information on a manufacturer's or exporter's supplier list. It continuously monitors suppliers at the third tier and below for sanctions involvement, dependence on a single country, opaque beneficial ownership, counterfeit parts and signs of supply disruption. HELIOS AEGIS runs the same analysis engine on a closed network isolated from external networks. It provides security briefings and strategic-materials supply alerts to defense and public agencies.The company points to two design choices. It treats an event as confirmed only when two or more independent signals agree, which it says sharply reduces false alarms. And because AEGIS runs on a closed network, data does not leave for overseas cloud services.

HELIOS has set up a U.S. entity, HELIOS Security Solutions LLC, to pursue defense and supply chain markets. It has named Taiwan as its second major target. Like Korea, Taiwan is a core hub of the global semiconductor and AI supply chain, and HELIOS sees strong demand there tied to compliance with Section 805 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024 (NDAA). The free pilot for Taiwanese parts makers and EMS companies is meant to open the door to local partnerships.

Two milestones are planned. HELIOS will file a core patent under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) in December 2026, and it will exhibit at CES 2027 in January in Gyeonggi Province's pavilion at Eureka Park.

Kim said HELIOS is based at Gyeonggi Startup Bridge in 2nd Pangyo Techno Valley, where it works with AI, semiconductor and software companies and uses GBSA's global support programs. After the DIGITIMES presentation, he said, the company aims to become an essential partner in managing sub-supplier risk for Korean and Taiwanese companies that supply global defense and IT supply chains.

body.x: Founded in 1998, DIGITIMES is Taiwan's largest technology media outlet. It runs Traditional Chinese and English editions and provides analysis on semiconductors, electronics, telecommunications and the ICT supply chain to technology companies and investors around the world.

Pangyo Techno Valley brings together Research (R), People (P), Information (I) and Trade (T) as a global convergence R&D hub built around IT, BT, CT and NT. Gyeonggi Province developed it as an innovation cluster to secure new growth engines for the country through technology innovation, workforce training, job creation and stronger international business competitiveness. To raise the valley's value, the Techno Valley Innovation Group at GBSA holds monthly programs such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day and the Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange - In-Best Pangyo, and supports overseas promotion that puts Pangyo companies, products and services in front of investors and media.
